settings.title: From Beach to Boat Deck
settings.body: Works on beach, paddleboard, rocks, hot sand, and boat decks. Open-toe design for ground feel, drainage channels for water, and the same injection-molded grip that locks in studio — now engineered for every surface outside it.

settings.title: Built for Outside
settings.body: Water-ready, heat-resistant, grip-locked on every surface.

settings.question: Grippy shoes for beach and hot sand
settings.answer: Hot sand, wet shoreline, rocky tidepools — Outdoor grippy shoes protect your feet while maintaining ground feel. Quick-drain design sheds water in seconds.

settings.question: Grippy shoes for boat decks and paddleboarding
settings.answer: Wet fiberglass, teak decking, inflatable SUP surfaces — injection-molded grip holds where rubber soles hydroplane. Lightweight enough to forget you're wearing them.

settings.question: Packable grippy shoes for travel and resorts
settings.answer: Roll them flat, toss them in your bag. From poolside to rocky coves to hotel gym — one pair covers every surface your trip throws at you.

settings.question: How do I care for Outdoor grippy shoes after water use?
settings.answer: Rinse with fresh water, shake out excess, air dry. The injection-molded grip and performance knit are engineered for repeated water exposure — no degradation, no odor buildup.

settings.title: 10% off your first pair.
settings.body: New drops, studio stories, care tips. Once or twice a quarter — never spam.
